rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's kitchen cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling and walls are direct property damage to the home's structure and contents, covered under homeowners property_damage coverage.
claim_summary: Kitchen fire caused by grease flare-up on stovetop, extinguished by policyholder. Charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Classified as property_damage with medium severity; estimated damage likely $2,000–$25,000.

case_facts.description: grease fire from stovetop sauté, extinguished with fire extinguisher; charred cabinets above stove; smoke damage to ceiling and walls
case_facts.estimated_damage: unknown - damage includes charred cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling and walls

rationale: Flooding to the policyholder's own basement structure (drywall, hardwood floor) and contents (stored boxes) indicates damage to the insured property, which is the hallmark of property_damage claims; most residential flooding scenarios involve water intrusion to the home itself rather than third-party liability.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement has flooded with approximately two inches of water affecting the entire floor. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, drywall soaked up to one foot high, and multiple ruined stored boxes. This is a high-severity property damage claim with estimated damage likely exceeding $25,000 and requiring immediate professional mitigation.

case_facts.description: two inches of water throughout basement, buckled hardwood floor, soaked drywall up to one foot, ruined stored boxes

rationale: Wind damage to policyholder's own roofing structure is straightforward property damage with no third-party or theft elements involved.
claim_summary: Wind damage removed four shingles from the back porch overhang. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no water intrusion or secondary damage. This claim falls below the $2,500 deductible and may not result in a payout, but is routed for adjuster review and confirmation.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off
